chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Razzāz narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from Al-Khaybari, from Ḥusain ibn Muḥammad Al-Qummi, who said:

Abū Al-Ḥasan, Mūsā ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him) said: The minimum reward for the visitor of Al-Ḥusain (peace be upon him) by the shore of the Euphrates, if he knows his right and sanctity and Wilayah, is that he is forgiven for what preceded of his sin and what followed.

key_terms.بِشَطِّ الْفُرَاتِ: by the shore of the Euphrates

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Husain by the Euphrates?
ai.summary: Imam Mūsā ibn Ja’far (a.s.) highlights that the baseline reward for visiting the shrine of Imām Al-Ḥusain (a.s.) by the Euphrates, grounded in recognizing his rights and Wilayah, is the comprehensive forgiveness of sins. This narration underscores the transformative spiritual power of Ziyārah as a means of expiation, linking the physical act of pilgrimage to the metaphysical reality of divine mercy and the enduring legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt.
